_comment: Source of truth for the positions page. Hand-edited when a position is opened or closed; build.py adds the live price and derives R. The thesis is written AT ENTRY - a thesis composed at exit is marking your own homework, and the whole point of the page is that the claim was on the record before the outcome was.
_symbol_note: Yahoo symbols. Japan 225 uses NIY=F, the yen Nikkei future, NOT ^N225: the spot index closes with Tokyo while CMC's cash CFD tracks the future, so ^N225 reads about 0.8% away from the platform and puts the stop distance visibly wrong.
_r_note: 1R is the distance from entry to the initial stop. Every outcome on this page is quoted in multiples of it, so positions of different sizes are comparable.

open.name: GBP/CHF
open.thesis: Sterling pays 3.75% while the franc pays nothing, and the SNB has said it would meet a fast franc rally with intervention rather than negative rates. The position is long that gap and relies on the SNB meaning it.
open.catalyst: Opened nine days before the September MPC, with the market pricing the Bank's next move as a rise rather than a cut.
open.breaks: The MPC turns and starts cutting, or the SNB lets a safe-haven rally run without intervening.

open.name: Japan 225
open.thesis: The index is price-weighted and Advantest alone was 12.2% of it at the July review. Advantest and Tokyo Electron together explain about three quarters of its daily moves over the past year.
open.catalyst: Opened three weeks before the cap rule cuts Advantest's weight from 1 October and pushes passive money into the rest of the index.
open.breaks: Advantest and Tokyo Electron roll over. At those weights the other 223 cannot carry the index.

open.name: USD/MXN
open.thesis: Banxico is at 6.50% against a Fed at 3.50 to 3.75%, and the peso is the usual way that gap gets expressed. Crowded positions in it unwind faster than they build.
open.catalyst: Entered the day after the pair closed at a twelve-month low, having fallen 1.5% over the prior quarter.
open.breaks: Banxico cuts towards the Fed and the gap that pays the position closes.

_thesis_note: Three slots, all written AT ENTRY. thesis: what has to be true. catalyst: what made that day the day. breaks: what says it is wrong, which is not the stop being hit. An empty slot renders as an empty line rather than disappearing - see the position-thesis skill.
_dp_note: dp is DISPLAY precision only. The stored entry and stop keep their full precision, so R and the distance to the stop are unaffected by it.
_ccy_note: ccy is what the PRICE is quoted in: for a cross that is the quote currency (the second one), for an index the currency of the index.
_sources_note: Slot facts as at 10/09/2026. Policy rates confirmed on Bloomberg: UKBRBASE 3.75, SZLTDEP 0.00, MXONBR 6.50, FDTR 3.75. Nikkei weights and the cap from Nikkei Inc's own review announcement; the 73% figure is measured from Yahoo daily closes. Re-check before quoting any of them.
